title: Qualificação direta do corretor visual em deslocamento observável
hypothesis: Depois de um deslocamento visualmente observado na velocidade que o corretor usa, correct_reference pode recuperar a referência atual em malha fechada sem usar uma coordenada PTZ ou repetir um resultado incerto.

basis.previous_trial: E7R used 0.1 speed for 0.08 seconds. It moved 2.392 px and returned to 0.607 px by preset, so fine correction was correctly not entered.
basis.changed_variable: Only outbound duration changes to 1.0 second. The velocity remains 0.1, the maximum allowed by the production continuous correction policy.
basis.scope_limit: This qualifies direct visual correction from a known observed displacement. It does not yet qualify recovery after a large residual created by a preset recall.

recovery.method: correct_reference from the Toposync production module, with no GotoPreset before correction.
recovery.acceptance: quiet terminal frame, verified distributed correspondence, overlap >= 0.85 and displacement <= 3 px.
recovery.failure: Any unobserved, divergent, inconsistent, low-overlap or budget-exhausted result preserves the new preset and stops without retry.

forbidden: recall or deletion of presets preserved by E7
automatic retry after a rejected correction

persist_only: visual-anchor descriptor only when the recovery is unconfirmed

outcomes.pass: A direct visual correction reaches <= 3 px and removes the temporary preset after confirmation.
outcomes.inconclusive: The outbound move remains at <= 3 px, so the corrector does not run.
outcomes.fail_safe: The new preset and descriptor are preserved and the camera is not moved again automatically.

result.decision: The 1.0-second pulse at speed 0.1 exceeded the 35-pixel entry envelope. The fine corrector did not run; the temporary preset and descriptor were preserved for a separately designed recovery.
